detail.longDescription: Manual work might (eventually) get the job done, but it rarely scales. Whether it's following up with leads, sharing updates, or wrangling data across teams, as your processes grow more complex, so does the need for workflows that scale with you. That's where Zapier comes in. You can start by automating individual tasks with simple workflows—what we call Zaps—and grow into running entire systems across apps, teams, and data.
